newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain's Cantabrico 9-mth net up more 12 pct.
newsitem.headline: Spain's Cantabrico 9-mth net up more 12 pct.

text.p: Results for Spanish electricity firm HidroCantabrico for the nine months to end-September in billions of pesetas, unless stated:
NOTE - Hidroelectrica del Cantabrico SA said it will pay two interim dividends, each of 48.75 pesetas gross, on December 15 1996 and on March 15 1997.
Taking into account the two dividends already paid in June and September, total dividend paid against 1995 results is 195 pesetas per share.
Shareholders' funds totalled 108 billion pesetas at September 30.
The company added that self-production rose in the period to almost 23 billion pesetas, and operating costs fell around 2.6 percent in real terms, with financial costs down 12 percent.
The company had debts of 85.99 billion pesetas at the end of September, unchanged from the end of 1995.
The natural gas subsidiary increased results by 36 percent and turnover by 34 percent, the firm said.
